info.title: host/artifact/v1/artifact.proto
info.description:
The artifact interface: a person's consent to an exact authored artifact a
module runs (an agent's configuration, an intent version), for one
installation, under one policy. A policy is a resource kind: approving
requires its `activate` action at the module, running requires its `run`.
Consent is given in person and read back at every run; it is never a
credential to execute or read anything.
